craft_notes: Sthāyin: season — rival school dated. Rows: span then fulfillment. Read aloud: seasonal arc.

lines: From bright Āṣāḍha to Kula-full-moon's close wear the thread;
Kārttika's dark fifteenth fills either wheel: so Night-Tantra's knowers.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra āṣāḍhaśuklāt kulapūrṇimādināntaṃ kāryaṃ pavitrakam tatra kārttikakṛṣṇapañcadaśī kulacakraṃ nityācakraṃ pūrayati iti śrīnityātantravidaḥ
